etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Borrowed from Latin pīus (“pious, dutiful, blessed, kind, devout”), from Proto-Indo-European *pewH- (“pure”). Cognate with Old English fǣle (“faithful, trusty, good; dear, beloved”). More at feal.
senses: Of or pertaining to piety, exhibiting piety, devout, god-fearing.
Relating to religion or religious works.
